title: Looking for long term collaborators and genuine investors.
author: Significant_Two_1524

comments.author: Ok_Map5721
comments.body: for anyone reading: drawdown 89% at 1:1000 leverage, the balance chart shows the account near zero in november before a new deposit, absolute gain is 92% while the headline 871% is deposit-adjusted, and the EA is "constantly tweaked", so 8 months isn't one system. I'd want a public, verified track record of one unchanged version before putting anyone's 10k behind it.

replies.author: Significant_Two_1524
replies.body: Okay, so the 89% drawdown was in April when there were a few position open over the weekend and trump had announced something, the drawdown never hit the actual capital as over the weekend itself the capital was pulled as the announcement came on Saturday, the consequences of that were anticipated and hence the capital was pulled and only lost the margin that was actually engaged (this is the only reason to use higher leverage, as the system works on a fixed lot size and fixed SL points, and the size is based on MC ruin run which has blow up probability of less than 1%). The balance shows near 0 because the it was not live since last week of September till 1st week of November as, I was working on making the system more robust and avoid the choppy market (which we saw from 2nd week of September till 3rd week of October). The tweaks aren't constant or random, they are minor input changes made on the basis of monthly performance analysis and only if needed.

replies.author: Ok_Map5721
replies.body: thanks for explaining. that actually makes my point though: the worst drawdown was saved by you pulling capital by hand, and the system was switched off by you during the choppy stretch. a partner running the EA on their own account gets neither of those. so the record shows the EA plus your judgment, not the EA alone. a verified track of one fixed version, running through a bad stretch without intervention, is what would convince me.
